promises.quote: At national level, as part of our mission to build an NHS fit for the future, we will make sure mental health care is delivered in the community wherever possible - through new models of care and support available for those who are struggling - so that more people are prevented from needing to go into hospital.

promises.quote: The Trust (SWLStG) fully acknowledges the concern regarding insufficient bed capacity in London and the reason why the Coroner has cause to raise these concerns.
promises.summary: Acknowledge concern and commit to improving bed capacity

links.explanation: Both reports highlight delays in securing appropriate mental health beds due to insufficient bed capacity, which can worsen patient conditions.
links.earlier_quote: MHSC say that following the death of the deceased, a new policy has been introduced so that there is no waiting time at all for the allocation of a bed
links.later_quote: Witnesses confirmed that no suitable bed was identified until approximately after 15:00 on 12 April 2022, which then became unavailable.

followups.summary: The Trust acknowledged concerns about insufficient bed capacity in London, but no source confirms a specific action was taken or a timescale provided.
